fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: ItemId of the Workspace, empty for platform-level actions.

fields.name: ProjectId
fields.description: ItemId of the Project the action touched, if any.

fields.name: ActorUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the acting user.

fields.name: ActorIsSuperAdmin
fields.description: True when the actor acted as super admin.

fields.name: Impersonated
fields.description: True when the action ran through impersonation.

fields.name: TargetType
fields.description: Kind of record the action targeted.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.
